blocks.text: My recommendation is to pay the maintenance fee on the older patent now. Decide its long-term value when the review reaches its family.

The reasons, in order:
1. Paying keeps the patent in force for {{fact:f:E-2019-001.client}}. It commits you to nothing beyond this payment.
2. The fee is a published official fee. Under our engagement letter it is billed at cost.
3. A lapsed patent can sometimes be revived by petition. The petition requires a statement that the delay was unintentional, and a deliberate decision to wait would not support that statement.
We pay maintenance fees only on your written instruction. A reply to this message is enough. Kelly Snyder will confirm to you once the payment is recorded.
Of the three items Kelly Snyder asked for, the inventor agreements come first. The title review cannot close without them.
